presents.line: The gypsy who begged for your presents
stanza: You take away homes from the homeless
And leave them to die in the cold
The gypsy who begged for your presents
He will laugh in your face when you're old

presents.line: My only question is, "Where my presents?"
presents.linePrev: Told her that "You the star at the top of my Christmas tree"
presents.lineNext: She said, "Shhh," she got a gift for me that ain't for the kids to see
